en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large equestrian statue on a tall plinth in the foreground. The rider wears historical military dress and a plumed hat. Behind the statue are low town buildings; one has signage reading "SALUHALLS KAFFE" and "SALUHALL". In the background stands a square church tower with a clock and a domed roof topped by a cross. A cyclist rides across the cobbled square.
